content: CSS scroll-snap with 'scroll-snap-type: x mandatory' on container and 'scroll-snap-align: start' on children enables native browser horizontal snap between days. Key properties: scroll-snap-type (container), scroll-snap-align (children), scroll-padding (container offset for fixed headers), scroll-snap-stop: always (prevent skipping). Browser support: universally available in all modern browsers since 2019. Best used as progressive enhancement or full mechanism. Two viable patterns for React: (1) CSS-only overflow-x scroll + snap — no JS needed for snap but requires IntersectionObserver/scroll events to sync state. (2) State-driven translateX — controlled via useState, no scroll events needed, cleaner state management. Pattern 2 preferred for calendar because it keeps selectedDay state deterministic and syncs mini-bar without debouncing.
